subject: Platform-wide: game XP + global scoreboard silently dead on ~272 game pages (GameTracker loaded without FirebaseAuth+FirestoreManager)
description: Found 2026-08-02 while QCing cloud-iam-debugger: 279 pages load GameTracker.js but only 7 load FirestoreManager.js, and BOTH the FirestoreManager.addXP path and GameTracker._submitToCloud path hard-require the FirebaseAuth global FIRST (GameTracker.js:237 returns before even checking FirestoreManager). So on ~272 game pages the '+XP Awarded' completion banners are localStorage-only and the submitGameScore CF (functions/index.js:337, rules firestore.rules:187) never receives scores. WORSE (Nancy, verified): the '7 covered pages' are not uniform -- wsa/games/cloud-save-the-pod.module.html loads FirestoreManager WITHOUT FirebaseAuth and is silently broken the same way despite looking covered; gauntlet and m20-failsafe-capstone show the CORRECT pairing (FirebaseAuth.js then FirestoreManager.js). cloud-iam-debugger fixed with the correct pairing 2026-08-02 as the reference. Fix shape: add the FirebaseAuth+FirestoreManager pair (in that order) to game pages -- but DISCUSS SCOPE FIRST: 272 files is a shotgun; consider whether GameTracker should dynamically load its own dependencies instead (one-file fix in GameTracker.js vs 272 page edits). Verification bar per Nancy: a signed-in browser pass confirming the CF call actually succeeds -- harnesses that stub auth cannot see this defect class.
activeForm: Working on: platform-wide game XP/scoreboard wiring gap
